note: A 60 W RGBWW lensed LED panel. Specifications table: CCT "2,500K~7,500K", CRI "≥95" (cri 95 is that lower bound), TLCI "≥96", "Beam Angle ( No Accessory) 45°", "Max Power Output 60W", "Max Power Consumption ≤78W" (power_w 78, the stated maximum), "Max Light Output 6,300 lux @ 1m". The shop page gives "5,900 Lux @ 1 meter (5600K)": the entry uses the specifications table's maximum and keeps both here. Modelled as a spot of the stated 45° beam (type spot); its luminous flux is not stated, so the lighting study cannot size it until a flux or luminance is entered. Not stated in what was read: luminous flux, emitting size, mass, IR output.
interface: Bluetooth 5.0 (Sidus Mesh), Sidus Link app; on-board controls
